DVD-Audio MLP PS1 Fixture Data
Source: Bowie David Live DVD-A, ATS 1 AOB 1
AOB 1 starts at ISO LBA 14143
Sector size: 2048 bytes

aob_sectors_0_99.bin:
  100 raw MPEG-2 program stream sectors from AOB sector 0
  204800 bytes total
  Each sector: 14-byte pack header, then PES private stream 1
  Sector 0: PES starts at offset 32 (18 bytes of system header first)
  Sectors 1-99: PES starts at offset 14 (immediately after pack header)
  PES private stream 1 (0x000001BD) contains:
    - PES header (variable length, includes PTS)
    - sub_stream_id: 0xA1 (MLP)
    - DVD-Audio private header: cyclic counter (1 byte) + first_access_unit_pointer (2 bytes)
    - MLP payload data

ps1_mlp_payloads_sectors_0_99.bin:
  PS1 payloads extracted from those sectors, concatenated
  201479 bytes, 100 packets
  Each packet: sub_stream_id (0xA1) + cyclic (1 byte) + AU_ptr (2 bytes) + MLP data
  Packet 0: 1994 bytes (sector 0 has shorter PES due to system header)
  Packets 1-99: 2015 bytes each
  Packet boundaries at offsets: 0, 1994, 4009, 6024, 8039, ...
  NOT a pure MLP elementary stream — includes PS1 framing per packet

aob_sectors_48191_48210.bin:
  20 raw sectors from AOB sector 48191 (Group 2 track 2 start)
  40960 bytes, mid-stream MLP data
  For comparing cross-ATS extraction at track boundaries

MLP access unit headers (f8726fbb pattern):
  Appear every ~2000-2500 bytes throughout the data
  Sector 0 alone contains ~10 access unit headers
  This is a dense MLP stream (48kHz/24-bit/6ch)
  The MLP major sync word on this disc is f8726fbb (not f8726fba)
